name: Console Error Diagnosis
description: Read the shared Browser console, separate warnings from blocking errors, and confirm a repaired error is gone.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the page that produces the console output.
Read console and page errors for this session.
Read the application file named in the stack.
Find the code the stack trace points at.
Confirm the URL the errors were collected on.

validation.rule: Console output from browser_console_errors is cited, warnings are separated from blocking errors, and a repair is confirmed only by a later console read that no longer shows that error.
